clusters.name: snapshot-core
clusters.executionModeRationale: These stories all change the nested snapshot shape and restore path in worktree-snapshot.mjs, so they must be implemented as one serial core slice to avoid incompatible snapshot schemas.

clusters.name: copilot-guard-integration
clusters.executionModeRationale: This depends on the safe snapshot core because it re-enables the guard and asserts child-launch behavior; it should run only after the core fast-path and budget semantics are stable.

clusters.name: release-metadata
clusters.executionModeRationale: Release metadata must be serialized after behavior and tests are known so the version notes accurately describe the shipped surface and all six stamps remain in sync.
